en: Black‑and‑white interior view of an elegant hall with high decorated ceilings, chandeliers, tall windows with drapes, parquet flooring, and classical wall paintings. Several armchairs, small round tables, and chairs are arranged in the room. White caption text at the bottom identifies the location as the Stefanien­saele in Graz and mentions the foyer with the painting 'Apollo unter den Hirten'. The publisher credit 'ERIKA‑VERLAG – GRAZ' and number '1258' also appear.
